individual-data-points.explanation: Spatial heatmap-style plots showing deconvolution scores per spot; heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Box plots already display the data distribution (and individual jittered points are additionally shown), so this is exempt/PASS.
GSEA enrichment score line plots are exempt, as overlaying individual points on line plots is not meaningful.
Bar chart shows log2 fold change per gene from DEG analysis with only p-values annotated; no individual data points, replicate values, or variability are shown behind the bars.
Panel E consists of micrograph/IHC images, not a quantitative plot, so individual data points are not applicable.
